// Chokepoint fixture (tests-network-imports, RUN-29): a test importing undici
// and node:http directly instead of going through tests/helpers/local-servers/.
// It sidesteps the V5 MockAgent entry point and the local-server helpers, so
// the test no longer exercises the http.ts egress gate — the rule must flag it.
import { test } from 'node:test';
import { MockAgent, setGlobalDispatcher } from 'undici';
import { createServer } from 'node:http';

test('sneaky direct network test', async () => {
  const agent = new MockAgent();
  setGlobalDispatcher(agent);
  const server = createServer((_req, res) => res.end('ok'));
  server.close();
});
